summary.text: Mary Morrissey is a Republican state representative from Vermont who represents the Bennington-5 District and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia gives her tenure in the Vermont House as beginning in 1997, and she works as a sales and marketing consultant.

paragraphs.text: Mary Morrissey was born in Bennington, Vermont, and received her diploma from Mount Anthony Union High School.
She is a sales and marketing consultant.
In the Vermont House, Morrissey was assigned to the Corrections and Institutions Committee in 2023-2024, and was its ranking member in 2021-2022.
She advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026.
